Class OverlayText

java.lang.Object
net.murat.lovert.Overlay
net.murat.lovert.OverlayText
public class OverlayText extends Overlay
2D text overlay. Font resolution order: 1. A file named fontFace inside ttfDir (if set). 2. A system font family named fontFace (e.g. "serif", "sans-serif"). The rotation pivot is the center of the measured text bounds, so a rotated overlay attached to a corner does not spill outwards from that corner. Text size is given as a ratio of the image height.
